statement: The record identifies the lot as a recently carved African elephant-ivory tusk imported from Cameroon in 2015, so despite its “permitted” status, publishing it would present serious U.S. wildlife-trafficking compliance concerns.
judge_text:
WRONG
It contradicts the record's "permitted" status, stating the 2014-carved, 2015-imported African ivory would raise "serious U.S. wildlife-trafficking compliance concerns" if published.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
